newsitem.title: CANADA: Gold price favors small Toronto gold stocks.
newsitem.headline: Gold price favors small Toronto gold stocks.

text.p: Optimism about gold bullion favored small and mid-tier gold companies on the Toronto Stock Exchange on Tuesday morning, analysts said.
Gold bullion closed in London on Tuesday at US$383.30 an ounce, up from US$382.05 on Monday.
"The action is really in the mid-size and exploration stocks," John Ing, president of Maison Placements Canada, said in an interview.
"Drill hole stocks are getting a lot of investor attention."
The majors were heavily traded but holding steady.
Exploration in Indonesia propelled a group of stocks on Tuesday morning.
Goldstake Explorations Inc was up C$2.12 to C$3.30 in trading of more than 2.6 million shares after releasing encouraging assay results from its Soreang concession in Java.

Borneo Gold Corp on the Vancouver Stock Exchange moved up C$1.20 to C$11.25 before trading was halted Tuesday morning. The stock bounded ahead more than C$8 on Monday after it said it hard started sampling at its Indonesian holdings.
And Bre-X Minerals Ltd was up C$0.90 to C$26.90 in trading of almost 800,000 shares.
Investors are intrigued with exploration companies these days, said analyst Barry Cooper with Wood Gundy.
"They feel they can get better leverage, more bang for their buck," he said in an interview.
